selection: Jan-May log wealth minus half absolute max drawdown; reject train drawdown below -50%; top 1% shortlisted, Jun-Jul same-objective winner; Aug-Sep retrospective holdout inspected after selection
regime: Prior 20 observed valuation sessions QQQ USD return >3% and above MA20 = up; <-3% and below MA20 = down; otherwise range; first 21 sessions unknown.
price_basis: split-adjusted Close, dividends excluded; all values KRW; same-date local closes not synchronized
disclosure_rule: Latest snapshot as_of STRICTLY BEFORE local execution calendar date
execution: Earn existing positions close-to-close return then rebalance at current local close; freeze closed-market positions, no leverage, cash in KRW with zero interest

fees.includes: assumed commission + slippage + currency exchange allowance
fees.terminal: mark to market, no forced sale fee

first_entry: All accounts begin cash; first disclosure-following date benchmark entry; strategy waits in cash until its first eligible signal; subsequent rebalances calendar-based
targets: Strategy cumulative percentage return >=2x or3x EACH ETF cumulative percentage return; ratios defined only for positive ETF returns. This is not multiplying ending wealth.
stress: selected daily path by prior-information regime
chronological monthly walk-forward with switch surcharge
limitations: retrospectively retrieved holdings; historical publication timestamp not verified
252720 parameter rows are correlated and include duplicates; count unique rounded return paths separately
holdout is retrospective, not future/live validation; no proof of 2x/3x future returns
eight-plus-month history cannot validate an entire bull/bear cycle
prices/features use only this sample; full lookback required, no external warmup
